# media

ffmpeg video helpers: re-encode a file down to a sane size and report the before/after saving.

---

## `media_shrink_video`

Re-encode a video to a smaller MP4 and report the size saved. Defaults to H.264 CRF 28 with faststart so the result streams. Output defaults to <input>_shrunk.mp4 next to the input.

> **⚠ DANGER** — Overwrites <output> when it already exists — prompts first.

**Usage**

```sh
media_shrink_video <input> [output]
```

**Examples**

```sh
media_shrink_video screencast.mov
media_shrink_video raw.mp4 /tmp/small.mp4
MEDIA_VIDEO_CODEC=libx265 MEDIA_VIDEO_CRF=30 media_shrink_video big.mp4
MEDIA_OPEN_AFTER=1 media_shrink_video clip.mov
```

**Requires** `ffmpeg`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/media.sh:32`](../../modules/common/media.sh#L32)
